_about: Canonical TW3-C RUS conversion tables. Deterministic input to backend/tw3/scoring.py.
source_reference: stage_to_score: Jing Gu, Yongming Meng, Haoxin Meng, 'Deep Learning Approach for Bone Age Assessment Based on Improved TW3 Scoring Method', AIPR 2023, Table 1 (Bone Development Grade Scale), grades 1-8. Transcription verified: both sexes' maximum-grade totals sum to exactly 1000 (TW3-RUS design invariant). score_to_age: digitized from the same paper's Figure 8 'Standard' bone-maturity curve (PROVISIONAL, approximate +/- ~0.5y; refine with a precise CHN/TW3-C curve).
notes: TW3-C (Chinese) RUS. Uses 8 numeric grades, NOT the A-I letters of the original TW3. Bone ages diverge from this centre's historical original-TWIII reports: e.g. the case-001 films score 880 here vs the reported original-TW3 RUS 681. Doctor-supervised: every result is reviewed and approved.

population_fit._about: Evidence justifying TW3 as the method for Indian children, plus the known Indian-vs-Western bias. Sourced from research brief task T1 (2026-07-06). These references justify the METHOD CHOICE only; they do NOT alter any stage_to_score or score_to_age value here, and no numeric correction is applied.

known_bias.boys: ~6 months delayed vs Western standards across ages; least precise in pubertal boys.
known_bias.girls: delayed pre-puberty (~2-6 mo, ages 2-12); may be advanced (~0-6 mo) ages 12-15.

population_fit.caveats: No India-specific TW3 stage->score or score->age table exists in the free literature. These TW3-C (Chinese) tables are the closest freely-available reference; the score_to_age curve remains provisional (see source_reference).

references.cite: Shah et al. 2021, Indian J Endocrinol Metab
references.finding: TW3 most accurate of GP/GR/TW3 in 851 healthy Indian children (lowest RMS error); best for girls and prepubertal boys.

references.cite: Patel et al. 2012, Forensic Sci Int
references.finding: GP skeletal-age delay of ~0.7 yr in Indian boys and ~0.33 yr in girls (1-19 yr).

references.cite: Khadilkar et al. 2022, J Pediatr Endocrinol Metab
references.finding: Automated BoneXpert (GP/TW) validated in 920 Asian-Indian children; carpal bone age retarded, more so in boys.

curve_validation._about: The score_to_age curve is DIGITIZED (provisional, +/- ~0.5y). To clear the 'provisional' flag on real evidence, enter this clinic's own historically-reported TW3-C films: each case = the confirmed 13 RUS grades (bone code -> grade '1'..'8') and the known/approved bone age in years. The curve is treated as locally validated only when at least min_cases cases reproduce within tolerance_years (scoring.validate_curve). Until then every bone age stays labelled provisional. Nothing here changes any stage_to_score or score_to_age value; it only measures how well the shipped curve fits local cases. Example case (remove, do not ship real patient data here): {"id": "case-001", "sex": "girls", "stages": {"radius": "8", "ulna": "7", "mc1": "8", "mc3": "7", "mc5": "7", "pp1": "8", "pp3": "7", "pp5": "7", "mp3": "7", "mp5": "7", "dp1": "8", "dp3": "7", "dp5": "7"}, "expected_bone_age_years": 13.0}

stage_to_score._fill: stage_to_score[sex][boneKey][grade] = RUS points (grades 1-8; ulna has no grade 8).

score_to_age._fill: PROVISIONAL ascending [rusScore, boneAgeYears] anchors digitized from Fig 8 Standard curve.
